description: generic trivia and a failed self-check are rejected; a 'What does X' question about the project is not

questions.question: What does HTTP 404 mean in general?
questions.explanation: A 404 status code means the requested resource was not found.

questions.question: Which field of WatchContext changes on every rescan in Orbit?
questions.explanation: WatchContext in src/index/watcher.rs keeps a generation per scan.

questions.question: What does WatchContext keep to drop the events of an older scan?
questions.hint: Look at the struct's only field.
questions.explanation: WatchContext in src/index/watcher.rs keeps a generation; events of an older one are ignored.

questions.question: Is it best practice to debounce file system events in general?
questions.explanation: Typically, debouncing avoids reacting to every single event of a burst.
